selection.bestFor: Dental practices positioning around holistic patient wellbeing, total health, and a no-nonsense 'your health comes first' philosophy — particularly general dentistry, preventive care, and whole-health dental practices that want to feel more like a wellness brand than a clinical office.

strategy.background: warm parchment/cream inner content canvas set against an outer sage-olive background — the site frame is olive-green, the content area is cream. Two-color surface system: all content lives on the cream, olive is structural framing.
strategy.saturation: split — muted olive/earth tones for structure and text, one saturated electric-yellow accent for emphasis and active states
strategy.accentUsage: bold and intentional — the yellow accent (#E8D800 / near-chartreuse) is used for in-image headline overlays, submit button fills, and key callout backgrounds. It is the single high-chroma moment in an otherwise earthy muted palette. Used sparingly but unmistakably.
strategy.surfaceStrategy: Single cream content surface (#F2EDDB) on a structural olive-green frame (#636840). No nested card surfaces within content — the cream canvas itself is the single light surface. Image cards carry the only true contrast, with full-bleed photography in rounded-lg containers. Olive green is used for filled primary CTAs, section headings in context, and the outer page chrome. Yellow is reserved for in-image text overlays and the highest-emphasis interactive element (newsletter submit button, contact CTA background).

type.substitutionCriteria: Display face must be a compressed or condensed sans-serif at ExtraBold or Black weight — a true high-impact condensed face like Syne ExtraBold, Barlow Condensed Black, or similar. Must render at ALL CAPS with tight tracking. The extreme weight and width compression are load-bearing to the character; a regular-width bold sans will not substitute. Body face must be a clean regular-weight sans at 14–16px with comfortable line-height — no personality required. Both faces should feel earthy and direct, not geometric-minimal or techy.
type.pairing: ExtraBold/Black condensed-sans ALL CAPS for all display headings and in-image text overlays, paired with a plain regular-weight sans for body copy, descriptions, and UI text

heading.eyebrow: none — this design system does not use eyebrow chips above headings
heading.eyebrowTreatment: n/a — category labels appear as small ALL-CAPS inline tags inside image cards (e.g. 'DAILY RITUALS', '01 / HARMONY'), never as pill chips above headings
heading.emphasisDevice: yellow accent fill (#E8D800) applied to in-image headline overlays and the largest statement headings within image card contexts — not used in standalone section headings, which stay in olive/dark text

type.contrast: very high — the gap between the massive black condensed display and the small regular body is the core typographic statement

reference.displayFace: Syne ExtraBold, Barlow Condensed Black, or similar compressed/condensed sans at 800–900 weight
reference.bodyFace: Inter, DM Sans, or similar neutral clean sans at regular/400 weight
reference.inImageTag: Same condensed sans at small size ALL CAPS for category metadata within image cards (e.g. 'DAILY RITUALS', 'MINDFUL FLOW')

shape.cornerRadius: large — image cards use lg/xl rounded corners (approx 16–20px). Buttons use pill radius. Input fields use md-lg radius. No sharp corners on any interactive or image element.

elevation.system: flat — no drop shadows. Depth is achieved by the olive frame vs cream content contrast and by full-bleed photography within rounded containers.

border.treatment: hairline outline — pill-outline buttons use a single hairline border in the heading/olive color with transparent fill. Input fields have a visible but subdued border. No decorative borders on content sections.

button.treatment: split — primary CTA is filled olive/dark with cream text; secondary/more CTA is pill-outline transparent with olive border and text; newsletter submit is filled yellow with dark text. All three use pill radius.
button.character: Three button types: (1) Filled dark-olive pill — primary action ('START TODAY', 'Book Appointment'). (2) Pill-outline transparent — secondary/contextual actions ('MORE', 'Contact Us') — these appear at card level, small, hairline border only. (3) Filled yellow pill icon-button — used for the newsletter submit action, carries maximum visual weight. No icons on filled primary buttons. No medium or large radius — always pill.

label.character: Small ALL-CAPS inline text labels within image cards — not pill chips. Positioned as a small identifier above or alongside the in-image headline (e.g. '01 / HARMONY', 'DAILY RITUALS', 'MINDFUL FLOW'). No border, no background — plain small-caps text in cream or muted tone against the image. Used as a counter/category signal rather than a navigation element.

tokens.density: open — generous whitespace within the cream canvas. Sections have substantial vertical padding. The boldness of the typography creates perceived density at the heading level, but the surrounding whitespace is very open.
tokens.motion: subtle — hero image carousel with previous/next arrow controls. No elaborate animations inferred; the bold static character of the type system dominates.

sections: hero — split asymmetric layout: massive ALL-CAPS headline left, body copy + pill CTA upper right; full-bleed image hero-card below with in-image yellow overlay headline and category tag + description
programs — ALL-CAPS section heading with 'MORE' pill-outline link top right; 3-column image cards with large rounded corners, ALL-CAPS olive title below image, price, and pill-outline 'MORE' button
author — author/doctor introduction section (visible heading at bottom of screenshot 2)
blog-articles — dual-column image cards with category tag + yellow ALL-CAPS title overlay at bottom of card, and description below
testimonials — 4-column compact quote cards with 5-star rating, quote text, avatar, and author name
contact — statement headline ('YOU DON'T NEED MORE PRESSURE — YOU NEED SPACE TO FEEL BETTER') on yellow background with inline contact form
journal — large ALL-CAPS 'WELLNESS JOURNAL' heading, subline, newsletter join widget (with avatar stack, join count, email input + yellow submit), and 2-column image article cards

composition.hero: Two-zone layout on the cream canvas. Upper zone: left side holds a massive 3-line ALL-CAPS ExtraBold headline ('WELL-BEING / COMES FIRST') in dark olive text — the headline spans approximately half the viewport width. Right side holds a small 2-line body copy description in regular sans, followed by a single filled olive pill CTA ('START TODAY') below the body text. The two zones align top. Lower zone: a large full-bleed image card with xl rounded corners showing a close-up human face. Within the image, a small ALL-CAPS category tag ('01 / HARMONY') sits top-left; a centered ALL-CAPS category label ('MINDFUL FLOW') sits mid-card; the main in-image headline ('FIND YOUR BALANCE') renders in the electric yellow accent at ExtraBold weight. Bottom-right of the card holds a 2-line description in white. Carousel arrows (plain circles, left and right) flank the image card. No background color behind the headline — the cream canvas IS the hero background.
composition.nav: Minimal bar on the cream canvas. Brand wordmark/logo left-aligned. Navigation links centered or right. A single pill CTA far right. No complex multi-column nav. The outer olive-green frame is visible above and around the content, acting as the browser-chrome color rather than a nav background.
composition.programs: Full-width section on the cream canvas. Section heading 'PROGRAMS' in large ALL-CAPS ExtraBold olive text, left-aligned. A small pill-outline 'MORE' link sits top-right aligned with the heading. Three equal-width columns each contain: a large full-bleed image with xl radius (landscape/portrait crop, warm-graded wellness photography), followed by an ALL-CAPS ExtraBold olive title (2 lines), a 1-line description in small regular sans, a bold price line ('$1,800' / 'Starting at $3,500' / '$497'), and a small pill-outline 'MORE' button. Column gap is generous. No category chips, no metadata tags.
composition.author: Author/doctor feature section — visible only as a heading in screenshot 2. Likely a split-image layout with author portrait and bio copy.
composition.blogArticles: Two-column grid of image article cards. Each card: large full-bleed image with xl radius (portrait crop), a small ALL-CAPS inline category tag ('DAILY RITUALS') positioned inside the image at upper-left, and an ALL-CAPS ExtraBold headline in yellow (#E8D800) rendered at the bottom of the image over a subtle dark gradient. Below the image: a 1-line description in regular sans. No price, no chips, no CTA per card — the card itself is the click target.
composition.testimonials: Four compact cards in a horizontal row on the cream canvas. Each card: a star rating display (5 filled stars) top-left with score label, 3–4 lines of quote body text in small regular sans, and below that an author avatar (small circle) + author name and location in small sans. Cards are borderless — separated by column gaps only. No background on cards, no border radius visible — flat inline.
composition.contact: High-contrast statement section. Left half: a large 3-line ALL-CAPS ExtraBold headline ('YOU DON'T NEED / MORE PRESSURE — / YOU NEED SPACE / TO FEEL BETTER') on a bright yellow (#E8D800) background. Below the headline: social icon links and a phone number + email address in small sans. Right half: a contact form on the yellow background with labeled input fields (Name, Email, Message) each with a rounded input box and muted border, followed by a filled dark pill CTA ('START TODAY'). The entire section has a yellow fill — this is the one full-section accent color usage.
composition.journal: Section on the cream canvas. Large ALL-CAPS ExtraBold heading ('WELLNESS JOURNAL') left-aligned, spanning most of the content width. Below: a small italic subline ('Your guide to balance, energy, and daily rituals'). Upper-right: a newsletter signup widget — an olive-background rounded card with a small avatar stack (3 user avatars), bold 'JOIN 1,000+ READERS' heading, a 1-line descriptor, a cream rounded text input ('Join newsletter*'), and a small yellow filled pill button with '+' icon. Below: a 2-column grid of article image cards in the same style as blogArticles (image + yellow in-image headline + category tag + description).
composition.footer: Minimal footer on the cream canvas. Logo and nav links. No dark background. Copyright line.

novel.name: Asymmetric Headline + Image Hero Card with In-Image Yellow Overlay
novel.spec: Two-zone hero on the cream canvas. Top zone: left-aligned ALL-CAPS ExtraBold headline (3 lines, ~70–80% viewport width) in dark olive; right-aligned single body text block + pill CTA ('START TODAY') occupying the upper right quadrant. No background image behind the text zone. Bottom zone: a single large image card (~70% viewport width, xl radius, full-bleed) that fills horizontally below the headline. Inside the image card: small inline ALL-CAPS counter label top-left (e.g. '01 / HARMONY'), centered ALL-CAPS category label mid-card (e.g. 'MINDFUL FLOW' in small white sans), a 2-line ALL-CAPS ExtraBold in-image headline in electric yellow (#E8D800) at center (e.g. 'FIND YOUR BALANCE'), and a 2-line white description text bottom-right. Carousel navigation: two circle-outline arrow buttons flanking the image card horizontally (left and right edges). Dental translation: hero card becomes a practice photography carousel (team, office, patient care moments) with bold yellow-overlay headline per slide.

novel.name: Program Cards — Image-First with Price and Pill-Outline CTA
novel.spec: 3-column (or 2-column) grid of service/program cards on the cream canvas. Section header: ALL-CAPS ExtraBold heading left + pill-outline 'MORE' link right — both on the same baseline row. Each card: (1) large full-bleed image with xl corner radius (approx 16–20px), warm wellness photography; (2) ALL-CAPS ExtraBold olive title below image, 1–2 lines; (3) 1-line description in small regular sans in muted olive; (4) a bold price line ('$X,XXX' or 'Starting at $X,XXX') in regular sans; (5) a small pill-outline 'MORE' button (transparent fill, olive hairline border, small text). No category chips, no metadata. Dental translation: each card becomes a dental service (e.g. 'DENTAL IMPLANTS', 'CLEAR ALIGNERS') with a starting-from price and 'LEARN MORE' pill-outline CTA.

novel.name: Statement Headline on Yellow Section with Inline Contact Form
novel.spec: Full-width section with an electric-yellow (#E8D800) background fill. Left half (approx 50%): a 4-line ALL-CAPS ExtraBold statement headline in dark olive ('YOU DON'T NEED MORE PRESSURE — YOU NEED SPACE TO FEEL BETTER'). Below the headline: a row of 3–4 small social icon links, then a phone number and email address in small regular sans. Right half (approx 50%): a simple inline contact form — three labeled input fields (Name, Email, Message) with rounded cream-background boxes and muted borders, followed by a single filled dark-olive pill submit button ('START TODAY'). The yellow background extends across the full section width. No card wrapper — the yellow IS the section background. Dental translation: headline becomes a patient-care statement ('YOUR COMFORT COMES FIRST — YOU DESERVE DENTAL CARE THAT LISTENS') with appointment request form.

novel.name: Journal Section with Embedded Newsletter Signup Widget
novel.spec: Content section on the cream canvas. Left side: a massive ALL-CAPS ExtraBold heading ('WELLNESS JOURNAL' / dental: 'PATIENT RESOURCES') and a small italic subline below. Upper right: a self-contained newsletter/notification widget — an olive-dark background rounded card containing: (1) a horizontal stack of 3 small circular user avatars, (2) an ALL-CAPS ExtraBold heading ('JOIN 1,000+ READERS'), (3) a 1-line descriptor, (4) a cream-background rounded text input field, (5) a small yellow filled pill submit button with '+' icon. Below the heading row: 2-column article card grid (image + yellow in-image title + category tag + description). Dental translation: section becomes 'DENTAL HEALTH RESOURCES' or 'PATIENT EDUCATION', newsletter becomes appointment or updates signup.

imagery.crop: Varies by use — hero image card and article cards use close-up or medium crop, often centering on a human face, neck, or upper body. Program cards use medium or full-body lifestyle crops. All images fill their container completely with no white space visible around edges.
imagery.grading: Warm, golden-hour tone throughout. Lifted shadows, slight desaturation in shadows, warm highlights. Skin tones are warm and luminous. No cool or clinical grading — everything leans toward earthy amber-warm. The overall look is natural, outdoor, and sun-touched rather than studio-lit.
imagery.framing: Human subjects are the primary focus — close to medium crop showing face, torso, or lifestyle pose. Environmental context (outdoors, natural light, plant life) visible in backgrounds. No sterile white-background photography. Subjects are at ease, often eyes closed or in contemplative/joyful expressions.
imagery.subjectTreatment: Wellness lifestyle imagery — subjects in natural settings, warm light, relaxed or energetic expressions. Diversity is visible across cards. No clinical imagery — no equipment, no chair, no sterile environments. The dental translation would use warm, approachable, candid-feeling dental and team photography rather than procedure shots.
imagery.imageTextRatio: image-heavy — large images fill most of each card; text content is concise and brief below

voice.rhythm: Short, declarative phrases. Statement headlines are bold, provocative, and welfare-forward ('YOU DON'T NEED MORE PRESSURE'). Body copy is brief — 1–2 short sentences, plain language. Price is stated plainly without softening. The overall voice is confident and permission-giving rather than clinical or cautious.
favors: second-person direct address ('you need', 'your body', 'meet you where you are')
wellness and whole-person language ('balance', 'energy', 'resilience', 'your body and mind')
permission-giving and low-pressure framing ('space to feel better', 'guide you', 'sustainable')
plain-spoken benefit language without clinical jargon
bold statement copy that challenges conventional thinking ('You don't need more pressure')
transparent pricing — price shown openly without qualification
avoids: clinical or procedure-heavy terminology in patient-facing copy
superlatives or credentialism ('best in the city', 'award-winning')
overly long sentences or paragraph-heavy copy

gaps.detail: Asymmetric split hero with in-image yellow overlay headline and carousel image card has no matching variant in the standard hero pool — all standard hero variants are either centered or simple left/right split. Requires novel component.

Program/service cards with image + ALL-CAPS title + price + pill-outline CTA are not the same as alternating-rows or standard card-grid. The ALL-CAPS ExtraBold typography AND price display AND pill-outline 'MORE' button together are a distinct pattern requiring a novel component.

Statement-headline-on-yellow-background contact section with inline form has no match in the standard CTA pool. The full-section accent-fill pattern is structurally different from a card or centered CTA. Requires novel component.

Journal section with embedded newsletter widget has no standard match — the embedded olive-dark signup card sitting within the content hierarchy next to the section heading is a unique layout pattern. Requires novel component.

The ALL-CAPS ExtraBold condensed display face is a hard dependency — a generic bold sans will not reproduce the character. The builder must provide a real condensed Black weight font (Syne ExtraBold, Barlow Condensed Black, etc). The archetype collapses without this.

The electric-yellow accent (#E8D800) is used at full-section background scale in the contact section — not just a button or label. This is an unusual accentUsage pattern that may conflict with builders defaulting the accent to small UI elements only.

fidelityChecks: All section headings and in-image titles must be ALL CAPS using a condensed ExtraBold/Black weight font — sentence-case headings will break the archetype entirely.

The hero must use the asymmetric two-zone layout: large standalone ALL-CAPS headline top-left with body copy top-right, then a full-width image card below — do not use a centered hero or a hero with a background image behind the headline.

In-image headlines inside the hero carousel and article cards must render in the electric yellow (#E8D800) — not in white or olive. Yellow is the in-image text color, not a section background by default.
The contact/CTA section must use the full-section yellow background fill — this is the primary use of the accent color at section scale. Do not reduce it to a card or banner.
Buttons come in three distinct types: filled dark-olive primary, pill-outline transparent secondary, and filled-yellow submit icon-button. Do not collapse all buttons to a single type.
Image cards must use xl rounded corners (16–20px) — no sharp corners, no small radius on photography containers.
Category tags within image cards are small inline ALL-CAPS plain text — not pill chips with borders. Do not use the eyebrow-chip pattern from warm-editorial systems.
Pricing must be displayed prominently below program/service titles — not hidden or disclosed only on detail pages.
The outer frame (olive green) is structural, not navigational — nav lives on the cream canvas, not the olive frame.
Body copy must stay at 1–2 short sentences maximum; this is a visual-dominant system where images and bold type carry the message, not paragraphs.
The newsletter/signup widget inside the journal section must sit as an embedded dark-background card alongside the section heading — not as a separate full-width footer banner.
Star ratings in testimonials must be visible — the rating display is part of each compact testimonial card.
